problem:
A logistics manager tracks the total distance $s$, in kilometers, traveled by a delivery drone. The following table shows the drone’s speed.

| **$t\,\text{(minutes)}$** | $5$ | $10$ | $15$ | $20$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ${s}^{′}(t)\,\text{(km/min)}$ | $0.42$ | $0.48$ | $0.53$ | $0.58$ |

At $t=10,$ the drone had traveled $4.6$ kilometers. Use the tangent line approximation of $s$ at time $t=10$ to estimate the distance traveled at $t=11.$  Do not round the answer.

The distance traveled by the drone at $t=11$ minutes is estimated to be
{{field-1}}
kilometers.
